slides.title: Chaos Consuming You?
slides.narration: Drowning in mess? Chores pile up, time vanishes! Imagine... a home that cleans itself, almost.
slides.imagePrompt: A wide-angle shot from a slightly high angle, capturing a surreal domestic scene. Everyday objects like laundry baskets, scattered papers, and a half-eaten breakfast are suspended mid-air in a swirling vortex around 'Alex'. Alex stands with a hand pressed to their forehead, a distorted clock face melting in the background. Lighting is dim and oppressive, with stark contrasts. Color palette is muted grays, desaturated blues (#4A6A7D), and a touch of sickly yellow (#E0B04A). Mood is frantic and desperate. Rendered in Surrealism style.
slides.sfxPrompt: Rapid ticking clock, muffled city hum, distant sigh

slides.title: Touch. Transform. Simple!
slides.narration: Trapped by the mundane? A single touch... and transformation begins! Unlock surreal simplicity!
slides.imagePrompt: Close-up, slightly low-angle shot on 'Alex's' hand, which holds a smartphone displaying the Cleanic App logo, glowing with an ethereal light. The phone acts as a portal, with glowing light spilling out, subtly distorting the background. Behind the hand, a previously messy corner of a room begins to dissolve into a clean, pristine, almost architectural void. Lighting is soft, warm, and inviting, emanating from the phone itself. Color palette shifts to hopeful aquamarines (#00C896) and soft whites (#F8F8F8) against the fading grays. Mood is hopeful and mysterious. Rendered in Surrealism style.
slides.sfxPrompt: Gentle electronic chime, subtle whoosh, shimmering light effect

slides.title: Cleanic: Effortless Excellence!
slides.narration: Cleanic App: Professional, effortless, pristine! Your home, sparkling! Reclaim your space, instantly!
slides.imagePrompt: A wide, dreamlike shot of a pristine, minimalist interior space, but with surreal elements. Abstract, translucent representations of cleaning tools (a feather duster, a mop, a spray bottle) float gracefully like celestial bodies in the room. Each tool emits a soft, internal glow. The floor is a reflective, impossibly clean surface, mirroring the floating objects. Lighting is bright, diffused, and almost angelic. Color palette is dominated by pristine whites (#F8F8F8), soft blues (#0057E9), and a hint of sparkling gold (#FFD700). Mood is serene, innovative, and pristine. Rendered in Surrealism style.
slides.sfxPrompt: Subtle sparkling effects, gentle electronic hum, soft whoosh of floating objects

slides.title: Book. Relax. Reclaim!

slides.imagePrompt: A medium shot of 'Alex', now completely serene and relaxed, floating comfortably on a cloud-like sofa above their pristine, surreal living room. They are reading a book, a soft smile on their face. The room below is immaculately clean, with exaggerated, flowing lines and impossible perspectives that suggest ultimate tranquility.
